overview.title: Accounts
overview.empty: Add your first Account. Each bank account or card you want to track is one Account.

add.title: Add Account
add.description: An Account is one bank account, card, loan or wallet whose money you track.
add.name: Name
add.nameTooLong: A name has at most 200 characters
add.currencyHelp: The currency of this Account's statements. It can't be changed later.
add.startDateTooLate: The start date can't be later than today
add.startDateHelp: The day this Account's history begins. Your first statement file must cover from this day to today; rows booked before it are ignored. It can't be changed later.

connection.title: Create a Connection
connection.body: Tell us how your bank's statement files are laid out.

statement.title: Import the first statement
statement.body: Use a file covering everything from {{start}} to today. Its Export balance sets the Opening balance.
